description.value: You brush against a creature's thoughts and plant a single, simple suggestion. Choose one creature within range that can hear you and speak a short statement of 25 words or fewer. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or believe the statement to be true and act accordingly to the best of its ability, so long as the suggested course of action isn't obviously self-destructive.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
